issues.description: Even --tiny extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files that are not present, so the documented demo and integration test fail from a clean checkout.
Story loading has no built-in generation or fallback path despite README claims, making the pipeline dependent on absent external data.
The full run constructs/downloads the HuggingFace backend before validating that input data exists, wasting time and resources before predictable failure.
Vector artifacts are loaded without validating backend, layer count, d_model, emotion count, or shape compatibility with the configured backend.
Preference steering also trusts vector artifact shape and manifest compatibility, so mismatched artifacts can crash or produce invalid measurements.
HF steering hook does not validate vector dimensionality or layer compatibility before mutating hidden states.
HF preference score uses only the first token of ' good' and ' bad', which is tokenizer-dependent and not a robust preference probability.
Runtime and HF dependencies are lower-bound only with no lockfile, reducing reproducibility for research outputs and production reruns.
pca_components_for_variance accepts threshold 0 but still returns one component instead of zero components.
Config properties silently default to empty emotions and zero dataset sizes, causing later obscure stack/min errors instead of early validation failures.
The only end-to-end test currently fails because test fixtures or generated tiny stories are missing.
